### SMTP and TLS

*  SMTP historically not encrypted
   *  typical idea: mail messages should be encrypted if needed
   *  (but hard to encrypt header information usefully....)
*  "opportunistic"
   *  after finding mail server, connect with TLS
   *  hope not interfered with by attacker
*  MTA-STS: mechanism to indicate (via DNS + HTTPS) to use TLS with SMTP
